entries.what: Rochelle gets up before dawn to pack Andre's two sandwiches and thermos for his 5 a.m. overtime shift, then drives the van to Tamsen Valley and parks in Lot C. She sits through Dr. Okoye's 9 a.m. anatomy lecture next to Linh.
entries.outcome: Andre left on time and she got a decent seat for lecture.

entries.what: She eats leftovers from the blue cooler bag in the van in Lot C, then walks the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for 30 minutes to loosen her back.
entries.outcome: Back eased up before the afternoon.

entries.what: At home she reviews her color-banded index cards at the kitchen table after 9 p.m. once the house is quiet.
entries.outcome: Finished the muscle cards and went to bed.

entries.what: Rochelle goes to Tamsen Valley for Tuesday intro chemistry at 11 a.m. and decides the 4 p.m. study group is no longer optional. She tells Aaliyah she needs her to handle the Tuesday pickups.
entries.outcome: Aaliyah agreed to cover the 4 p.m. pickups.

entries.what: Aaliyah drives Loretta to her pharmacy and checkup run at 3:30, the Tuesday trip Rochelle used to do herself.
entries.outcome: Loretta's Tuesday run was handled without Rochelle.

entries.what: Rochelle attends Pedro's 4 p.m. anatomy study group at the library with Linh, and Pedro brings Gus the skeleton.
entries.outcome: She stayed the full session for the first time as a firm commitment.

entries.what: Rochelle attends anatomy at 9 a.m. and the Wednesday lab, then packs leftovers and eats in the van.
entries.outcome: Got through the lab without trouble.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her 10 a.m. dispatch break and chats while nagging about studying. Rochelle takes the call in the hallway between lab sections.
entries.outcome: Short call; Keisha said to study tonight.

entries.what: Evening at home she folds laundry with her old hospital drama on, then does timed practice questions at the kitchen table with the timer.
entries.outcome: Finished a timed set on the kitchen timer.

entries.what: Rochelle goes to intro chemistry at 11 a.m. and then stops by Denny Wu's office to plan spring, noting that registration opens Nov 18 and she wants Anatomy II and Microbiology.
entries.outcome: Spring plan set: Anatomy II and Microbiology.

entries.what: Back home she checks the fridge paper calendar and shifts Andre's overtime and Aaliyah's evening shifts around dinner.
entries.outcome: Week's rides and dinners sorted on the calendar.

entries.what: She gets a lunchtime voice-note from Luisa with Ridgeline gossip about overtime quotas.
entries.outcome: Listened in the van; replied briefly.

entries.what: Rochelle attends anatomy at 9 a.m. Friday, then drives home through Halloween traffic near Marisol Gardens and Calle Ortega.
entries.outcome: Home before trick-or-treaters started.

entries.what: Halloween evening she hands out candy on Alder Court with DeShawn while Andre works late overtime.
entries.outcome: Ran out of candy around 8.

entries.what: After the kids are in bed she reviews cards at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Got through the nerve cards.

entries.what: Rochelle works her Saturday 8 a.m.-1 p.m. senior lunch shift at the Vinca Avenue Community Center.
entries.outcome: Shift went smoothly and her back held up.

entries.what: She shops at Ruiz Family Market for meat and the discount warehouse store for bulk, planning the Sunday batch cook.
entries.outcome: Bought chicken and rice within budget.

entries.what: In the evening she watches Andre fall asleep after his long day while she reads over notes.
entries.outcome: Quiet night.

entries.what: Rochelle goes to the Baptist church on Pell Road at 11 a.m. and later batch cooks baked chicken for the week.
entries.outcome: Week's meals prepped.

entries.what: Over dinner the family agrees she will host Thanksgiving for 14 people at Alder Court on Nov 27.
entries.outcome: She took on hosting Thanksgiving.

entries.what: Andre watches Sunday football and falls asleep by the second half while Rochelle writes the Thanksgiving date on the fridge calendar.
entries.outcome: Date on the calendar.
